# Competitor notes

Jonah · 2026-08-20 · Names left out on purpose; we compare approaches, not brands.

## Competitor A — streak counter app

- Strong onboarding; habit set up in under a minute.
- No offline mode: entries made on a plane are lost.
- Social features are public leaderboards, which our interviewees disliked.

## Competitor B — general journaling app

- Beautiful editor, rich media.
- No habits or streaks at all; people use tags as a workaround.
- Heavy upsell prompts inside the editor.

## Where Quillwend is different

Offline first, private shared streaks for small groups, and no ads inside the journal.
